company_info.company_description: "Our SAA Accredited Designers and Installers have been engineering systems tailored for the individual customers needs with both budget and performance in mind. Our design crew have access to the best tools, and we can provide shading assessments which allows for the best placement of panels to maximise your solar output.Since our inception, we have been entrusted with many larger scale commercial systems, including the 420kW IKEA Rhodes car park installation, which was completed in 2017. This system installation saw our portfolio range from 1kW Installations to 420kW."

reviews.review_description: Quoting process with Chris and Tom was easy.Installation was good. The guys were polite and cleaned up after themselves.The girls in the office/accounts were very helpful.Great job all round.

The whole process of quoting installing the system and the follow-up including phone app was a pleasant experience. We gained the feeling that it was definitely the right decision to deal with Case.The installers were helpful and competent as the completed job was very neat and tidy and functioning perfectly.Notification to Origin regarding installation handled by Case.

The quote was very well explained with clear options and a 3 week timeframe given for installation.The installation was completed within the 3 weeks and done in one day.The installation was first rate, the installers were very professional and cleaned up after themselves.Case Statewide also followed up with our Electricity Retailer to get the smart meter installed.I could not be happier with Case Statewide

Case Statewide Solar were very good to deal withI had many detailed questions when doing my research and they took the time to answer all of them thoroughly and to my satisfactionTheir pricing was very competitive and the installation was carried out on time and in a professional mannerI am extremely happy with my Sungrow hybrid inverter and batteries and the Jinko panels that they recommended

The process was simple, start to finish. Quite was well designed and clear and the installation was quick and well done. They also made a site visit before installation. There is one minor part yet to be done but overall I am very happy with Case.

This is my second time using Case Statewide Solar to instal a system for me. The entire team are friendly and professional from admin, quoting, through to installers. Second time around they didn’t disappoint, seamless organisation from start to finish and another job well done.
Appreciated All the help I got, it’s such a minefield of info to digest. Solar Quotes was the really good start getting my head around  all I needed to know.

Quote/Sale was On time and easy to understandInstall on time, nice crew and very tidyAll grid connection organisedAdmin/paperwork all in orderThe equipment app all set up and the system is working as expected.Great job by the Case Team
We choose Case Solar due to their good advice and explanations in lay terminology.The installation is not completed yet due to the Christmas break. Looking forward to the completed job.

Sales quoting process was good, alternate quote supplied after review of first quote, no pressure, queries answered, technical info supplied.Installation was carried out on specified date and completed on the day, looks good, tidy as per plan.Grid connection, and smart meter install after panel install, was organised, took longer than I had expected but within the 15 day period as originally quoted after I had followed up

A simple process from start to finish. The team at Case Statewide Solar understood my requirements, provided an easy to follow quote, and delivered above and beyond on promise of product. The installation team were professional, punctual, and installed exactly to design.  The finish of the product is outstanding, and the system itself delivers a phenomenal amount of energy. Case Statewide Solar comes highly recommended from my own personal experience.
Ohhh my goodness where do I beginEvery step of the way whey were helpfulEmployees were very polite and helpfulI can’t thank them enoughI highly recommend them trust me you won’t be disappointed

Thank you so much for doing a great job from start to finish on our Solar system. From quote to the end result, Case Statewide took care of every detail. The savings we made on this quality system is just the start. They listen to their customer and considered all our needs. Then they worked out the best system with the best return on our investment.When the onsite team finished the job and packed up for the day. i just had to personally thank each one on the team before they left. They were that good.Not only was the work done professionally, but above all, the team onsite were polite, considerate and very helpful. More than happy to recommend Case Statewide to anyone.

Sales and quoting process was prompt, well explained and we were very comfortable with the price and happy with both Chris and Tom who looked after us.The installation crew were a pleasure, extremely polite, efficient and the boys took great pride in their work. Cleaned up everything after completion, we couldn't ask for better.Great customer service and both the installation crew and girls in the office were extremely helpful with organising the grid connection paperwork.Would highly recommend Case for a quality and well priced solar system.

The team at Statewide were on point from the State.The design team designed a great cost effective system. Improving on the design of other quotes, taking out unnecessary cost but still delivering a great system.The Install was efficient. The team arrived on time and worked hard on a hot day to get the big install  done in just one day.Would recommend.
Quick and easy quote. Competitive pricing and answered all questions. Would recommend

Good at responding to my questions and modifying the quote to my spec that I was looking for.Communication was poor after and during the installation process, and seemed that office staff/installers were not communicating or informed of the processes.Quote - competitive and what I was looking for cost wise,Installation was done over multiple days, due to poor weather couldn't finish in the one day of panel installation, was told I would get told when they be able to fit me in again, Without any other communication showed up the next day to finish.they contacted my supplier about changing but - not getting clear information out of themoffered increased warranty
Same day quotes, extremely accommodating of our time needs. Got the job done quickly when we agreed to the sale

I followed your final recommendation. I don't know much about solar but your team was very helpful . I was offered cheaper quotes and was told your recommended solar company is too expensive. However my family decided to go with you. Thanks for your help..
I highly recommend CASE Statewide Solar. They were a pleasure to deal with and very professional. Tom and his team did an outstanding job from quoting, the design and installation of the system.
Case statewide solar company very helpful,  overall price extremely happy,  staff very friendly and cleaned up after finished job.  Would highly recommend them to anyone

In terms of pricing, I think we got some great products at a good price.  Some really good panels and an excellent inverter.  The installation team were really good.  Turned up early and worked very efficiently throughout the install.  Even when it rained part way through, they remained on site to see if the rain would pass and they were quick to get back to work as soon as it stopped to finish the job.Overall I'm really happy with the end result.

Very happy with the entire process.Had a first call with Chris months ago, with detailed options and quotation.We didn't proceed at the time, but when I reached out again and Chris was happy to come over for a site survey and refresh the quote, and we then placed an order and 10% deposit.A few weeks later the crew turned up on the day scheduled, all very polite and professional young blokes.They couldn't complete on the day due to rain, but came back the next business day to complete the job.Unlike many tradies they left the site spotless, which I really appreciate.They did a solid job, install looks great (6 panels facing east and 12 panels facing west).Now just waiting for a login to the SMA app so I can see the solar juice flowing.
Chris and the team were absolutely amazing and made the process effortless. Definitely will use them again for future houses

Searched and searched before I decided on the inverter and panel brand I wanted.Rang around for quotes and my causin recommended these guys.They recommended the same set up I found in my research.Install was super clean.They pointed out dodgy installs at the neighbours place.Top quality tradespeople not contractors rushing for a buck.
Great installer that installs quality products. They have great customer service and went above and beyond to make sure I was 100% happy with my system.

Very efficient, had the quote quickly, provided lots of information and was happy to answer any questionsInstalled system last week, guys were great, friendly, turned up when they said they would.Not yet connected to the grid, but they have booked it in, so should be done within the next week or so.Company was easy to deal with and they took care of everything. Would highly recommend.

Case Statewide Solar provided a prompt response and quotation using quality components and tailoring the system to our needs. The installation was completed shortly after proceeding with the quotation and up and running the same day. The team were very professional and punctual. They organised absolutely everything from setup, solar training also connection and notification to our energy provider. The whole process was simple and stress free all handled by Case Statewide Solar.  I highly recommend you consider Case Statewide Solar for your solar energy needs.

The quote was quick and easy to understand.The booking for the install was quite easy. There was miscommunication between the technician doing the installation and the sales team. As the technician advised me the invoice would be forwarded to me, where the sales team advised the invoice was the same one I received weeks earlier when I signed my contract.The only negative point so far is that it took 7 days for the paperwork to be sent to the supply (AGL) which is longer then I would have expected. As a result my installation was two and a half weeks ago and I am still not connected to take advantage of my solar panels.

Case Statewide Solar designed a panel system which maximized solar efficiency for our home. The quoting process and ability of the salesperson to explain things factually and clearly really helped throughout the process. All questions were addressed In a way which showed a practical understanding of solar systems combined with meeting our needs. Friendly and efficient, communication was great and the installation process was neat, tidy and quick. Everything from design, installation to liaising with our power company was covered, making this a stress free process. To top it off price was very competitive. This is a family owned business that looks after its customers.

Sales person was excellent, knowledgeable, helpful and patient. Quoting process was simple and straight forward.Installation Team were great, on-time, polite and knew what they were about and completed the installation efficiently. Tidied up and removed all packaging and leftover materials.Customer Service from the back office and admin leaves a lot to be desired. In fact I found this element of working with Case Statewide Solar very poor. There has been no after sales service to speak of. And the Customer Service team were slow to respond to phone calls. I got the impression that this part of the business is seriously under- resourced- had to chase up getting the Fronius Solar.Web system operational and interfacing with my phone and computer; was told that I had a poor internet connection which is not the case - as it is NBN optic fibre to house. The problem was that there had been an error with the Inverter set up.One month after installation we still have not received from Case Statewide Solar (despite ongoing requests) the Documentation Package as per the mandatory requirements in the Clean Energy Guidelines
Case Solar provided great service. Excellent communication. Quoted price was significantly cheaper than comparable systems.

The quoting process was excellent, happy to explain any queries and change things where necessary.They also did all the contact work with the electricity retailer and supplier.The installers arrived on time and proved to be quite obliging in answering any queries that arose, the job did take a little longer than expected due to a problem with the inverter and they had to come back the next day to make some adjustments.Overall the customer service was very good with both Tom and Chris happy to respond to questions both pre and post installation.

Everything went well, from the quote to the installation.They asked me if I wanted the inverter installed in the Garage, which I did, even though its on the opposite side of the house to the panels.They told me upfront how long I'd have to wait for the install.The install crew worked well and safely, tied off ladders and it rained so they had to stop and wait for the roof to dry, no risk taking or shortcuts.I'd recommend them to anyone, a very professional company.
1 - over the phone which we followed up with a visit to their business in Camden2 - All of it3 - In progress, awaiting reply from the company who supplied the Inverter
Sales quoting done via email.  Very goodInstallation excellentGrid connection completed by Case Solar
Professional installation on time and cleaned up afterwards they organised the grid connectionThe quote was thorough and informative

Installation was fine, system seems to be working good so far but it's been almost a year and I still haven't receive any paper works, manuals, etc.. and have to constantly chase them up and being ignored.

Sales/quoting is prompt. We decided to go with local & neighbourhood solar company. Busy company took 3 weeks to scheduled install. Installation was smooth, took only half a day. Now waiting for agl to change the Meter.

The supplied quote was the most extensive quote received with incredible detail and info about what they were offering. Chris obviously knows solar well and his answers to queries were clear and easy to understand. Our smart meter is due to be installed on Monday so hope to see some good info about the system via the app, which so far shows daily production etc. The installers were very professional but also left our home as tidy as it was when they arrived. The only thing required after the smart meter installation (others to do) is the documentation which I will receive after Case get the Govt rebate, which is OK by me
Case Statewide Solar after all our research on panels, converters etc gave the best advice, price and service.Installation was almost as if they weren't here and looks great.

Sales process was easy. Chris answered all of my questions clearly and was respectful each time I came back with more questions. I felt supported to choose the right system for our needs. The installation was timely and efficient and we have been provided with a great folder of all the paperwork relating to our solar system. Only thing missing from the service was an explanation about the inverter and how to monitor solar production. But that was sorted by a quick phone call.
Quote process was easy.Install was good and helpfull.Casewide solay were great to deal with

Comprehensive quote. Clear and simple terms and conditions.  Answered all my questions. I love the fact that they were not pushy or try to oversell. We sealed the deal when we were ready. Smooth install process on a hot day in December.  Polite tidy and punctual.  Grid connection paperwork included.  Great communication - very knowlegeble sales, install and after service. I highly recommend this family business and would recommend them to family and friends.

Great installation by Case Statewide Solar, friendly sales staff, willing to clarify any questions you may have. The installers were not contracted out which means they take pride in their workmanship.

Very good customer service throughout quoting period and with my follow up queries post installation. Chris Casey was a mine of information and very patient explaining it all to me. Tom was really good too. Installation guys were great.. Very professional, it all went smoothly. I'm yet to have my smart meter installed.. that'll be next week.

The quoting process was easy and accomodating, the installation was professional and the installers friendly, punctual and accommodating. So far the customer service has been good but we are still waiting for the new metering to be installed. No doubt this will occur in good time.

Good prompt response - Two quotes arrived the same day I sent in my request, with the 3rd installer responding the following day.I accepted Case's quote on 9/4/20 and installation was 16th & 17th. Someone came to commission the system early afternoon on 17th.The reason for accepting Case's quote was more "value for money". One quote was much more expensive, but top quality panels (at least more expensive panels), and I thought the lower cost was better value.No problems with the installers, they let me know what was going on, no unnecessary noise, etc.Our electricity supplier has contacted us about installing a smart meter, but no date yet.

These guys are good.  Customer service was great from the get go.  They were punctual with bookings and knew their stuff.  They sent someone out free of charge to set up the monitoring app for me the day after install as my Wi-Fi was down on the day.  There were a few things like that that mean I would recommend them to anybody.

Easy to work with and efficient at what they do. Their after sales service was a little slow and needs improvement especially in relation to responding to queries - we needed to prompt them several times to answer our emails. Overall, we were happy with their performance and would recommend.
Chris from case kept me informed all the way ,the appointment time and date was kept and there arrived on time and installation as excellent
Case Solar are professional, friendly, helpful, honest and best value. Fully recommend Case Solar for solar installation.They made the whole process straightforward and effortless.
very easy company to deal with

Case Statewide Solar kept me up to date of when they would do the install. The provided an excellent in depth quote and recommendation of the solar system. On the install day, I found the workers punctual, very skilled, it was a very quick install, they were very polite  and professional. Everything was installed cleanly and ahead of time even, I was surprised at how quick it was.
Easy to deal withGave clear choices as to options and limitationsInstallation was on time with no issues- Friendly installersAll aspect of the process handle by Case Statewide Solar staff

Tom gave us the best value quote for the system we chose, and the installers were punctual and tidy doing the work. He was easy to contact and was able to answer any question we had. The system has been in a month now and is working well. We paid a little extra to get a smart meter attached to the inverter which we can log onto at any time to see how much power is being generated and how much we are using at the time.

Very pleased with speed and convenience of installation and the efficiency of the solar production,Least satisfactory aspects of the experience have been the slownesss of AGL  to install their meter (3weeks) and the inefficiency of their communications and online mobile monitoring app.

The sale and quoting process was good. Chris came over onside after initial phone conversations. He was very patient in answering all my questions. The price was competitive. It was a time of missing communication after paying deposit due to their office moving. They helped to organise the grid approval and connection.The installation was also smooth and clean. Wayne and the team were polite and punctual.Change of panels and inverter due to supplier update were not communicated upfront. I was happy after Thomas gave me all the explanations and upgrade of inverter.I like the fact that they do all works by their own team, not subcontractor. Also they provide post sell monitoring, warrantee and services.

Thomas and Chris were professional from the quote to installation completion, the information and assessment for the panels were spot on from the beginning, the installation was done on the day as requested , the installers were great and polite. Looking forward to many years of low bills.

CASE Statewide Solar have been excellent from start to finish. From the initial quote, which was easily the most comprehensive, and the best price for the tier 1 gear on offer, through the installation and finalisation of additional elements (smart meter install etc), communication from and with CASE Statewide Solar has been excellent and I have no hesitation recommending Tom and his team.

Sales guy was not pushy and was quick to answer any questions, let us do things at our pace, only issue was paid deposit and had to chase up to see if they received it, Had to keep chasing installation side to get a date of installation as hadn't heard anything after 2 weeks. Installation was done around to suit us for when someone had to be home. They organised connections to grid and to the monitoring app.

Everything from the initial contact, follow up, quote information, installation etc was second to none. Chris contacted us directly and was happy to answer any questions as well as explain everything in detail. They were prompt in delivery and installation. Great company

Detailed quote provided. Follow up phone call asking if they could be of any further assistance. Invited us to showroom to show us products/explain how system would work. Installed promptly and professionally. Organised grid connection promptly.

Very professional company and very easy to deal with. Installation was very quick and tidy. They even fixed a broken outlet near by without being asked because he said â€œit wasnâ€™t safeâ€. Service went above and beyond. Could not recommend them more.

One of your recommended suppliers (space solar) did not send a written quote, after I told the salesman on site that his "estimate" price was too high. About $2k above the accepted quote. Shoalhaven solar was also high and did not seem to understand the site constraint issues.Case Statewide Solar did a comprehensive site survey and designed a system to suit the available space and orientation, slightly smaller than my preferred configuration, but a neat fit. Only installed yesterday, so no comments on performance so far.

All good, I contacted Case directly on the recommendation of two friends that had used them. No pressure from the sales side, they took a little while to confirm the install date but once confirmed everything went very well. I was happy with the quality and detail of the installation.

Case Statewide Solar were very good.  They were informative, answered my questions well and seemed to know what they were doing. We had a cheaper quote than Case Statewide, but I did not feel as comfortable with them, and they were not as local to my area as Case Statewide was.We got the cheaper Chinese Jinko panels because the premium panels were beyond my budget. (I hope I have done the right thing!)I would happily recommend Case Statewide Solar as a solar installer.

Good experience overall, small problem during installation but quickly sorted with a couple of phone calls. Would recommend Case Solar to others without hesitation. The information provided on the Solar Quotes web site was a big help in choosing a system from the many options offered by various suppliers.
Very helpful and patient in answering all my questions. The fitment team were pleasant, gave the appearance they knew exactly what they were doing and cleaned up after the job was completed.

We were extremely happy with Statewide Solar, Chris kept us informed every step of the way from the very first contact right through to the completion of the instillation.  The installers who are employees of Statewide Solar ( that was one of the reasons we chose them) were very polite, efficient and left the job clean and tidy. They also arranged within 24 hours of completion of the job for AGL to instal the smart metre. AGL have text us to say they will do that within 30 days, so let's hope they are as efficient.

I thought your site was very good and would be very helpful to first timers or even second timers like myself looking to get a great system ... I'm sure all of the suppliers that were sent to us via your site would provide a good system, however some three years ago when we were adding additional panels to our system on our old house, we got a bad installer ... hence my "trust" issues and deciding to stick with Tom Casey.
They had the most comprehensive Quote better than the other two
Case Statwide Solar are local - listened to us about the system and size we wanted - named the day of installation 3 weeks ahead and were here on the day.

The system is being installed today as I write this review, so I can't comment on that just yet. However the sales process was very simple and Chris from Case Statewide Solar was very patient on the phone and provided all the information I needed to make my choice. He followed up when he said he would but never pushed too hard.The whole experience was quite painless and we are looking forward to enjoying the benefits of the system.

Case solar followed up and answered all my questions and offered good advice. They met their installation deadline and even in the extreme heat that day they installed everything with a smile and did not stop.
Installed on date they said they would. Complete install with meter changeover  took 2 days.Excellent being able to monitor Solar output etc via Iphone or online.
Very co-operative with my other electrician who was upgrading my power to 3 phase. Highly recommended, very neat and cleaned up after no mess at all.

Quick installation, had to chase up about meter change over (that the installer mentioned) myself and have had no follow up call to find out if all ok. But apart from that have already recommended them to a neighbour.
Your website was extremely helpful in determining which system would be best suited to our needs.
I would highly recommend these guys. Xcellent service, good prices and very helpful.
Excellent customer service and good practical advice from your website.
Nil
The person we dealt with was very helpful and kept to all appointments made.
Tom from Case Statewide Solar is a pleasure to deal with. Everything was taken care of and was exactly as promised. I can highly recommend Case Statewide Solar.

Still waiting for them to come back and change the meter in the box so I can get a few cents per kWh I feed back into the grid. I think it has been installed even though they hadn't yet got the authority to install. They were the only company that contacted me through your service by the way.

Got a quote from a company that advertises 5kw systems for $4500 fully installed. Once I rang the quote grew to $8000 using inferior products. Then they pressured you to sign that day for the "special" price of $5500. When I requested the use of quality panels and inverter the price grew to $7000 quickly. If it seems to good to be true it probably is not true.

Solar is a great concept but to work in your favor  you must change your power usage habits and mostly do everything in the day .It makes it very hard when we have 40 degree days and no relief at night so the Air Conditioning stays on of a night and destroys what the Solar has saved you in the day .Im hoping i can add Storage Batteries to this system when available.Very Satisfied with Installer and would highly recommend
very happy. will recommend your easy alternative to trolling phone numbers and websites. Yours is a great service.
Make sure the installer repairs any broken or cracked roof tiles
